answer_1.quote: In this paper, we formulate a new problem: Multimodal Dialogue Response Generation (MDRG), that is, given the dialogue context, the model should not only generate a pure text response but also have the capacity to generate a multimodal response (e.g., containing both image and text).

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we focus on four aspects: (1) Image Intent Prediction... (2) Text Description Generation; (3) Image Generation Quality ; (4) Text Response Generation.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we randomly sample 200 dialogue contexts and generate responses from Pho-toChat for Divter and baselines. Three human annotators are asked to score the response quality on a scale of {0, 1, 2} from four aspects: (1) Context Coherence: Whether the text response is coherent with the context; (2) Text Fluency: Whether the text response is natural and fluent; (3) Image Quality: The quality (including definition and integrity) of the image response; (4) Background Consistency of Image
answer_4.guideline: Three human annotators are asked to score the response quality on a scale of {0, 1, 2} from four aspects: (1) Context Coherence; (2) Text Fluency; (3) Image Quality; (4) Background Consistency of Image
